notes.title: Patch 0.10.5 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Imaginytes – Update 0.10.5 is here![/h1] 💤✨
Thank you for all the feedback I have received! It really helps making the game better. Todays update brings some changes and new stuff based on this feedback, along with some fixes and tweaks.

[h2]🆕 Added[/h2]
• DPS-meter can now show damage by type and vitality healing
• New theme: Illusion of control, where you can select your start deck
• New theme: Power Nap, which makes the dream shorter
• New unique Psychic talent
• New unique Bot talent

[h2]⚙️ Changed[/h2]
• Imaginyte ability animation speed now scales with cooldown reduction
• Ability cooldown reduction is now capped at -75% (min 0.2 seconds cd)
• Abilities and attacks now alternate if both are ready (fixes an issue where Imaginytes could be stuck casting abilities forever)
• Minor rework of "A new beginning" theme, so you don't have to select a start deck
• Traits view layout to avoid overlapping with other UI elements
• Highlighting potential evolve targets on the map now has an additional effect

[h2]🐞 Fixed[/h2]
• Issue that could cause Flow projectile to get stuck
• Issue with Timo guide widget not resetting correctly between battles
• Issue where some guide widgets would not reset correctly when restarting a battle
• Added a fail safe to prevent losing battles if enemies bug out
• Issue where Po guide upgrades would not be saved properly
• Issue with Purity spell description
• Issue where some projectiles would not hit enemies properly on fast mode
• Trait talents icons looking weird
• Rare issue where some buffs, that should be counted more than once, only was counted once
• Issue when adding traits to an Imaginyte, it would not gain buffs from artifacts and talents

[h2]⚖️ Balancing[/h2]
• Relaxed gamemode essence reduction from -50% to -40%
• Minor changes to various talent values

Next up, I will start working on an endless mode. Please continue letting me know what you think of game, and if you have any ideas or feature request!

notes.title: Hotfix patch 0.10.4
notes.content:
Hi All,

A new patch, mostly with a few bugfixes. Thanks for reporting!

[h2]Version 0.10.4 [24/7/2025][/h2]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated Envenom description
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Visual issue where cards added during a battle would overlap guide widgets
[*]Issue where evaporating, recurring spells would not work properly
[*]Issue where Menace specialization could cause a critical error
[*]Issue where Netherworld could give more essence than intended
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]

[*]Reduced Dream of Fortune theme essence gain from +800% to +600%
[*]Reduced Netherworld tier 3 essence gain from +100% to +75% and tier 4 from +150% to +100%

notes.title: Patch 0.10.3 is live
notes.content:
Hi All,

First of all, again, thank you for all the feedback and reviews you have given me. This is so incredibly useful!!! Please keep it coming :D

Todays update brings some fixes to a few issues, a little QoL, and some small reworks to some of the traits. I hope this won't mess up the builds of anyone's ongoing runs too much.

[h2]Version 0.10.3 [23/7/2025][/h2]

[h3]Added[/h3]
[list]
[*]Toggle added to Imagipedia to match [b]any[/b] or [b]all[/b] Imaginyte traits
[/list]

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Redrawing and removing map features no longer unpauses the game
[*][b]Guard[/b] trait and retaliate slightly reworked:
[olist]
[*]Now deals flat damage instead of a percentage to improve early viability
[*]Now grants a portal shield on play
[*]Increased unlock condition for the Guard talent tree
[/olist]
[*][b]Furious[/b] trait slightly reworked:
[olist]
[*]Pop Off chance no longer scales with trait points
[*]Now deals damage to nearby enemies when popping off
[*]Mass Madness talent reworked into [i]Fire Fury[/i]
[/olist]
[*][b]Flora[/b] trait slightly reworked:
[olist]
[*]Evolve chance no longer increases with trait points, improving early viability
[*]Each trait point now increases poison damage
[/olist]
[*][b]Elemental[/b] trait slightly reworked:
[olist]
[*]Now applies Burn to all enemies in front when an Elemental enters play
[*]No longer increases poison damage
[/olist]
[*][b]Menace[/b] trait slightly reworked:
[olist]
[*]Fear chance no longer scales with trait points, improving early viability
[*]Menace Mastery bar now increases Fear chance
[*]Enemies take damage per Menace trait point when they start fleeing
[*]No longer provides extra Burn or Poison
[*][i]Real Menace[/i] talent now also applies Weakness
[/olist]
[*]Banners can now be removed from the map
[*]Greed is now rare and has been rebalanced
[*]Dismissing Imaginytes now requires confirmation
[*]Autopause toggle now remembers its last state between battles
[/list]

[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[list]
[*]Shock Starter artifact had incorrect range
[*]Report text box overlapping the slider
[*]Some achievements related to Lucidity, Flee, and Stun not tracking properly
[*]Sealed Contract causing an error in the shop in certain situations
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased starting Lucidity per enemy portal by 2 seconds for each one beyond the first
[*]Removing rocks with the Pickaxe artifact is now free
[*]Reduced stun chance for Molerico and Guaca, but increased their damage
[*]Slightly reduced Sin’s attack speed
[/list]

notes.title: Imaginytes - Update 0.9.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Hey Dreamers,

Version 0.9.0 is here with some exciting new additions, improvements, and balance updates based on your feedback. Here's what's new:

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] A new Dissolve reward option has been added to give you more flexibility in how you handle your deck.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The Dream map layout has been 3D-fied and various AI generated images has been removed
[*] Rerolls now display properly so you can better plan your choices.
[*] Rerolls are now available in the shop, giving you more control over what you find.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Various performance improvements to keep things running smoothly.
[*] Fixed some issues with guide animations.
[*] Cleaned up some older UI elements for a more polished experience.
[/list]

[b]Balance Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Treant enemies have been nerfed to make them a little less overwhelming.
[*] Overall difficulty has been slightly reduced to improve early run pacing.
[/list]

Thanks as always for playing and sharing your thoughts. Your feedback continues to help shape the world of Imaginytes.

Sweet dreams,
– Egome

notes.title: Patch 0.8.5 is here with some new and more interesting enemies!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
I'm excited to roll out Patch 0.8.5, now available for all demo players and beta playtesters. This update brings fresh content, key quality-of-life improvements, and a good chunk of balance and bug fixes. Here's what's new:

🔹 What's New in Version 0.8.5 (April 24, 2025)
✨ Added
Localization Support!
You can now play in:
[list]
[*] 🇰🇷 Korean
[*] 🇵🇹 Portuguese
[/list]

New Artifact:
[list]
[*] Dynamite – Boom! More ways to shake up your battles.
[/list]

New Enemies:
[list]
[*] Pixie Drake
[*] Fairies
[*] Mechanoids
[*] Slime
[*] Stonebark / Juggernauts (Phase 1 Boss!)
[/list]

🔧 Changes
[list]
[*] The first two battles can now feature Dream Lush.
[*] Recastable spells now have a new, more intuitive layout.
[*] Improved enemy type visibility during combat.
[*] Cleansing Spores no longer removes status effects.
[*] Battle encounters have been reworked for more variety.
[/list]

🐛 Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where rats stealing time would pause the timer.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where battles could end prematurely.
[*] Resolved a missing battle end countdown.
[*] Addressed various localization bugs.
[/list]

⚖️ Balance Tweaks
[list]
[*] Numerous enemies have been rebalanced to align with their new abilities.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who's been testing and sharing feedback. Your support helps me shape this game every step of the way. More updates are coming—stay tuned!

If you haven’t tried the demo yet, now’s a great time to hop in. 🧪💥

– Egome

notes.title: Patch 0.7.0 - Welcome Dream Guides!
notes.content:
0.7.0 is here with a lot of changes!

First of all, I have made a new Dream Guide concept. Before each dream you will select a guide spirit creature, that impacts how you play the game. Sort or a character mechanic from other similar games.

This update also brings a big UI overhaul, replacing a lot of images that felt out of place with a new simpler style. Mainly for the Imaginyte cards and the encounters. The hex grid has also gotten a small upgrade.

Various new spells and map features, as well as some new talents has also found its way.

Besides that 0.7.0 comes with various fixes, balancing and QoL. Enjoy ;)
